proposals.rationale: A numeric id string makes Number(id) a nonzero number, so the left operand of || is truthy and is the value taken.

from.reading: Number(id) || undefined takes the left side when Number(id) is truthy, e.g. id "1" -> 1

proposals.rationale: A non-numeric id makes Number(id) NaN, which is falsy, so || falls through to undefined.

from.reading: Number("abc") is NaN, falsy, so Number(id) || undefined takes undefined
